description: This PHP source file defines the TerminationReasonConfigurationDao class, which manages database operations related to termination reasons in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting termination reason entities, as well as checking for existing names and obtaining in-use IDs.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing termination reasons in the database, providing CRUD operations and additional utilities.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Persists a TerminationReason entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingTerminationReasonIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of termination reasons that exist among the provided list.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves a termination reason by its name, trimmed of whitespace.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on filter parameters, using a paginator.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for termination reasons filtered by specific parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Returns the count of termination reasons matching given filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes multiple termination reasons by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason with the given name exists.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of termination reasons currently associated with employees.
